subject: https://github.com/the-omega-institute/trureturing
summary: Sparse multiplication forces infinitesimal symmetries into orthogonal blocks; their dimensions cannot add up to eight. A focused explanation of the SL3 obstruction, with its precise limits.
summary_zh: 稀疏乘法迫使微小对称形成正交块，其维数无法相加为八。聚焦讲解 SL₃ 障碍及其准确边界。
title: Why eight directions cannot fit
title_zh: 为什么八个方向装不进去？
